articles.summary: Advances Rithm’s Expansion of Asset Management Platform Rithm Capital Corp. (NYSE: RITM) (“Rithm”), a global alternative asset manager, today announced the closing of a joint venture with a fund managed by DRA Advisors LLC (“DRA”) for the ownership of 1301 Avenue of the Americas, one of the flagship assets in the New York City office portfolio of Elecor Properties (“Elecor”), Rithm’s real estate operating platform. Rithm, through Elecor, will continue to hold majority ownership of the asset and operate the building on behalf of the joint venture. articles.title: Rithm Capital and DRA Advisors Announce Joint Venture for Ownership of 1301 Avenue of the Americas
